summary: Geopolitical alerts that can move oil. Scans every 10 minutes in the morning, every 5 minutes from noon to 10:00 pm, every 10 minutes late evening and every hour overnight (2:00 am to 8:00 am Singapore time) on weekdays, and every 3 hours from Saturday 3:00 am to Monday 3:00 am Singapore time. Counts and the net read cover the rolling last 24 hours; the feed lists all stored alerts.

alerts.headline: CENTCOM confirms the IRGC launched two one-way attack drones toward Bahrain and says US forces shot both down, with no injuries or damage, rebutting Iran's claim it destroyed a US early-warning radar
alerts.source: CENTCOM

alerts.headline: Iran's army says its navy shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Kuhestak on the Sirik coast near the Strait of Hormuz using a new naval air-defence system, and released wreckage images; no US confirmation
alerts.source: Tasnim News, citing Iranian Army statement (translated from Persian)

alerts.headline: IEA says member countries plan to release a further 71 million barrels of emergency crude and product stocks through end-February 2027, with about 15 million barrels of diesel; it also reports observed inventories rose 52 million barrels in October, the first build since June
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing the IEA Oil Market Report

alerts.headline: IEA monthly report: global oil market swings back to surplus as Gulf exports recover, with supply above demand for the first time since the Iran war began; it sees a 1.7 million b/d Q4 2026 surplus (previously a deficit), and Hormuz flows rose 440k b/d to 11.8 million b/d in October
alerts.source: FinancialJuice and FinSquawk, citing the IEA Oil Market Report

alerts.headline: IAEA's confidential quarterly report says it cannot conclude Iran has not diverted nuclear material, has had access only to Bushehr since June 2025, and has no clarity on the Isfahan enrichment plant
alerts.source: First Squawk, citing the IAEA report circulated to member states

alerts.headline: IRGC Navy says a liquefied gas tanker that ignored repeated warnings struck a naval mine on the southern (unauthorised) route through the Strait of Hormuz, causing a large explosion and fire; vessel not named
alerts.source: FinancialJuice, citing Iran's IRGC Navy; also MarketNews Feed and others

alerts.headline: Ukrainian OSINT says the overnight Volgograd refinery strike damaged ELOU-AVT-1 and AVT-6, units making up about 70% of the plant's primary crude processing capacity; a tank farm was also hit
alerts.source: Military Summary, NSTRIKE and other OSINT accounts on X

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones reportedly hit Transneft's Samara oil pumping and dispatch station (LPDS) at Prosvet, a major Russian crude pipeline and storage hub, for the second time this month
alerts.source: Exilenova+ (also Military Summary, Russian-language local posts)

alerts.headline: CENTCOM reportedly calls Israeli reports of imminent new US strikes on Iran 'pure speculation', saying US force posture in the region is unchanged
alerts.source: Mario Nawfal (citing CENTCOM statement)

alerts.headline: IRGC says it targeted a US early-warning radar in Bahrain in retaliation for an attack on a telecommunications tower in Sirik; no US or Bahraini confirmation yet
alerts.source: First Squawk, plus RedboxWire, FinancialJuice and TPObserver (citing IRGC statement)

alerts.headline: Trump tells Stephen A. Smith that Gulf nations have asked the US not to strike Iran, saying they 'would much prefer the waiting period'
alerts.source: OSINTtechnical on X (clip of Trump interview with Stephen A. Smith)

alerts.headline: Explosions and smoke at Bandar Lengeh on Iran's Hormuz coast after reported US strikes on Sirik; an Iranian air defence site was reportedly targeted
alerts.source: Open Source Intel (Osint613) on X, plus Post Open Source and Mario Nawfal (footage of drones along Hormozgan coast)

alerts.headline: Ukrainian drones reportedly hit Russia's Volgograd oil refinery (Lukoil) as the mass drone wave continues; footage shows fire, no official confirmation yet
alerts.source: markito0171 on X, plus UK_REPT, Illia Ponomarenko and others

alerts.headline: Ukraine launches one of its largest drone waves on Russia, reportedly 600-850 drones heading toward Moscow and central regions; Moscow airports reported closed

alerts.headline: Saudi-led coalition says it intercepted and destroyed two Houthi drones tonight, one over the Riyadh region and one over the oil-rich Eastern Province

alerts.headline: Iran's IRNA says Sirik in Hormozgan, on the Strait of Hormuz coast, was hit by 'enemy' fire in a military attack; attacker and damage not stated

alerts.headline: i24: a US official says Iran added new demands and 'overreached' in talks; sticking points are enrichment, shipping out the stockpile and sequencing

alerts.headline: Kan: a US official says CENTCOM has told Israel to prepare for a possible resumption of war with Iran; the US reportedly sent similar messages to Gulf states

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: explosions reported at Sarkhor Taheroi, 6 km from Sirik on Iran's Hormuz coast, following the reported missile launches from Bandar Abbas; cause not stated

alerts.headline: Houthis claim two new operations: a drone strike on Pumping Station No. 7 of Saudi Arabia's East-West crude pipeline and a strike on the Yanbu oil facility; they dispute a Saudi claim to have intercepted two missiles (translated from Arabic)

alerts.headline: Unconfirmed: more than 10 anti-ship cruise and/or surface-to-air missiles reportedly launched from Bandar Abbas toward the Strait of Hormuz; explosions reported in the city; targets unknown

alerts.headline: Houthis warn foreign businesses operating in Saudi Arabia must register with a Houthi-affiliated body in Yemen or risk being targeted by future strikes (SCMP)

alerts.eventTime: Afternoon of 12 Nov, Iran time (exact time not stated)

alerts.headline: UK government says it is sanctioning Russia's top ten oil producers, widening UK curbs beyond Rosneft and Lukoil; details not yet published

alerts.headline: Trump on Truth Social: 'We don't need a deal with Iran... We've got their money and we've got their Strait'; also redirects VP Vance to domestic crime, clouding the Vance-Rezaei talks idea; Brent erases losses, up ~1%

alerts.headline: IRGC Navy says a third tanker using an unauthorised Hormuz route exploded this afternoon after hitting a naval mine, after two supertankers overnight; vessel not named, no UKMTO confirmation

alerts.headline: WSJ: VP JD Vance weighs face-to-face talks with Iran security chief Mohsen Rezaei; Trump open to Vance restarting US-Iran negotiations

dayNote.title: Today's key developments
lines: CENTCOM says it shot down two IRGC drones fired at Bahrain, while Iran claims an MQ-1 shootdown off Sirik and an LNG tanker mine blast, and the IAEA cannot verify Iran's nuclear material.
Houthis claim strikes on Saudi oil sites and Ukrainian drones hit the Volgograd refinery, while the IEA sees the market back in surplus and plans a further 71 million barrel stock release.
